LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 2.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi
Topic 2.1: Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary, part of Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and clearly is enhanced as they listen and respond appropriately to three

directional instructions.

Values:
Responsibility: A learner engages in assigned roles and duties at home and at school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is improved as they learn about the duties at home and at school.

• Social studies as learners recite poems that address the theme of sharing duties and responsibilities, a theme taught in social studies.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner will apply attentive listening skills in learning of other concepts in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Audio recording or video clips

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Large print learners’ textbooks

● Braille books
